_comment: Example labeled sample for the adaptive calibration harness (docs/development-mode.md section 4). Labels are the expert verdict per issue: exactly 'plan' or 'default'. Build your real sample from your repository's own issue history (title + body + an expert plan/default verdict), then run: node js/adaptiveCalibrationHarness.js <sample.json>

issues.title: Settings page rework
issues.body:
Rework the settings page.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- User can change the display name
- User can upload an avatar
- Avatar is cropped to a circle
- Changes persist after reload
- Validation errors show inline
- Loading state blocks double submits
